name: Microservices Gateway
description: High-performance API gateway built with Go + gRPC — routing 100K+ requests/sec across 20+ microservices with sub-5ms overhead. Features circuit breaking, rate limiting, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry.

name: Real-time Data Pipeline
description: Spark-powered ETL pipeline ingesting 50M+ events/day from Kafka streams — transforms and loads into TimescaleDB with Spark, enabling real-time analytics with sub-second query latency and automated Airflow orchestration.

name: Enterprise Dashboard (TypeScript)
description: Full TypeScript/React SPA with ECharts visualizations — real-time monitoring of 5,000+ IoT devices across 12 factories. Features role-based access, WebSocket live updates, and responsive design for mobile and desktop.

name: IoT Telemetry Platform
description: Java-based telemetry ingestion service processing 50M+ events/day from MQTT endpoints — buffered through Kafka, persisted in Cassandra and DynamoDB, with real-time alerting via gRPC streaming to TypeScript/React dashboards.

name: Identity & Access Management
description: Microservices-based IAM with SSO, MFA, and RBAC for HIPAA compliance. Built with Java for auth services, TypeScript + React for admin UI — serving 50K+ daily active users at 99.99% uptime at one-third vendor TCO.

name: Integrated Data Lake
description: Spark-driven data lake on AWS processing 12TB+ daily across 6 siloed sources — Spark ETL pipelines, Airflow orchestration, S3 raw zone with Glue catalog for BI and ML consumption. Reduced time-to-insight from 3 days to 4 hours.
